verses.sloka: ततो नारायणो देवो विषुणुः नियुक्तः सुर सत्तमैः ।जानन् अपि सुरान् एवम् श्लक्ष्णम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-१६-१॥
verses.transliteration: tato nārāyaṇo devo viṣuṇuḥ niyuktaḥ sura sattamaiḥ ।jānan api surān evam ślakṣṇam vacanam abravīt ॥1-16-1॥

translations.english: Although Omniscient lord Narayana knew the means to be employed, when he was requested by the best of devatas he spoke to them softly:
translations.hindi: मा 0 हशा भु ९ पञ्चदशः सगः —$9}— मेधावी त ततो ध्यात्वा स किश्चिदिदमुत्तरम्‌ । लब्धसज्ञस्ततस्तं तु वेदज्ञो नुपमन्रवीत्‌

verses.sloka: उपायः को वधे तस्य राक्ष्साधिपतेः सुराः ।यम् अहम् तम् समास्थाय निहन्याम् ऋषि कण्टकम् ॥१-१६-२॥
verses.transliteration: upāyaḥ ko vadhe tasya rākṣsādhipateḥ surāḥ ।yam aham tam samāsthāya nihanyām ṛṣi kaṇṭakam ॥1-16-2॥

translations.english: "What strategies should be adopted in the matter of destruction of that evilminded Ravana who is a thorn to the sages?".
translations.hindi: हे राजन ! में तेरे लिए अथर्वण बेद में कही हुई पुत्रेप्टिचज्ञ की विधि के अनुसार, सिद्धि देने वाला पुत्रेष्टियज्ञ करूँगा जिससे तुम्हारा मनोरथ पूरा होगा

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्ताः सुराः सर्वे प्रत्यूचुः विष्णुम् अव्ययम् ।मानुषम् रूपम् आस्थाय रावणम् जहि संयुगे ॥१-१६-३॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktāḥ surāḥ sarve pratyūcuḥ viṣṇum avyayam ।mānuṣam rūpam āsthāya rāvaṇam jahi saṁyuge ॥1-16-3॥

translations.english: When the devatas were thus addressed by the imperishable Visnu, they replied him saying, "You may assume the form of a human being and slay Ravana in the battle".

verses.sloka: स हि तेपे तपः तीव्रम् दीर्घ कालम् अरिंदम ।येन तुष्टोऽभवत् ब्रह्मा लोक कृत् लोक पूर्वजः ॥१-१६-४॥
verses.transliteration: sa hi tepe tapaḥ tīvram dīrgha kālam ariṁdama ।yena tuṣṭo'bhavat brahmā loka kṛt loka pūrvajaḥ ॥1-16-4॥

translations.english: "O destroyer of foes Lord Brahma was very pleased with Ravana's intense penance over a long time৷৷
translations.hindi: पद्चदराः सग: १२३ ` तब तो देवता, गन्धर्वे, सिद्ध और महर्षि, अपना-अपना यज्ञ- 'भाग लेने को आकर यथाविधि जमा हुए

verses.sloka: सन्तुष्टः प्रददौ तस्मै राक्षसाय वरम् प्रभुः ।नानाविधेभ्यो भूतेभ्यो भयम् न अन्यत्र मानुषात् ॥१-१६-५॥
verses.transliteration: santuṣṭaḥ pradadau tasmai rākṣasāya varam prabhuḥ ।nānāvidhebhyo bhūtebhyo bhayam na anyatra mānuṣāt ॥1-16-5॥

translations.english: Pleased, with the rakshasa Brahma granted a boon to the effect that except from men, there was, for him, no fear of death from any other living beings. Ravana ignored men while seeking the boon.
translations.hindi: इस यज्ञ में यथाक्रम एकत्र हो देवताओं ने स्रृष्टिकर्ता ब्रह्मा जी से विनय की

verses.sloka: अवज्ञाताः पुरा तेन वरदाने हि मानवाः ।एवम् पितामहात् तस्मात् वरदानेन गर्वितः ॥१-१६-६॥
verses.transliteration: avajñātāḥ purā tena varadāne hi mānavāḥ ।evam pitāmahāt tasmāt varadānena garvitaḥ ॥1-16-6॥

translations.english: Having obtained the boon from Brahma, Ravana, greed and arrogant went on bringing destruction to the three worlds. He carried away women by violence. O destroyer of foes his death is possible by men only."
translations.hindi: हे भगवन्‌ ! (आपकी कृपा से रावण) नामक राक्षस, अपने बल से हम सब को बहुत सताता है और हम उसका कळ भी नहीं कर सकते

verses.sloka: उत्सादयति लोकान् त्रीईन् स्त्रियः च अपि अपकर्षति ।तस्मात् तस्य वधो दृष्टो मानुषेभ्यः परन्तप ॥१-१६-७॥
verses.transliteration: utsādayati lokān trīīn striyaḥ ca api apakarṣati ।tasmāt tasya vadho dṛṣṭo mānuṣebhyaḥ parantapa ॥1-16-7॥

translations.english: Having obtained the boon from Brahma, Ravana, greed and arrogant went on bringing destruction to the three worlds. He carried away women by violence. O destroyer of foes his death is possible by men only."
translations.hindi: क्योंकि आपने प्रसन्न हो उसे पहले वरदान दे दिया हैं इसलिए हम सब उस वरदान का आदर करते हए उसे त करते हैं

verses.sloka: इति एतत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा सुराणाम् विष्णुः आत्मवान् ।पितरम् रोचयामास तदा दशरथम् नृपम् ॥१-१६-८॥
verses.transliteration: iti etat vacanam śrutvā surāṇām viṣṇuḥ ātmavān ।pitaram rocayāmāsa tadā daśaratham nṛpam ॥1-16-8॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of devatas, selfpossessed Visnu chose king Dasaratha as his father.
translations.hindi: वह तीनों ,लोको को सता रहा है और लोकपालों से शत्रुता बाँध कर, स्वगं के राजा इन्द्र को भी नीचा दिखाना चाहता है ॥=।। ऋषीन्यच्षान्सगन्धर्वानसुरान्त्राह्मणांस्तथा । अतिकामति दुर्धर्षो वरदानेन मोहितः

verses.sloka: स च अपि अपुत्रो नृपतिः तस्मिन् काले महाद्युतिः ।अयजत् पुत्रियाम् इष्टिम् पुत्रेप्सुः अरिसूदनः ॥१-१६-९॥
verses.transliteration: sa ca api aputro nṛpatiḥ tasmin kāle mahādyutiḥ ।ayajat putriyām iṣṭim putrepsuḥ arisūdanaḥ ॥1-16-9॥

translations.english: At that time, the brilliant king (Dasaratha), destroyer of enemies, who had no sons was performing a sacrifice for sons.

verses.sloka: स कृत्वा निश्चयम् विष्णुः आमन्त्र्य च पितामहम् ।अन्तर्धानम् गतो देवैः पूज्य मानो महर्षिभिः ॥१-१६-१०॥
verses.transliteration: sa kṛtvā niścayam viṣṇuḥ āmantrya ca pitāmaham ।antardhānam gato devaiḥ pūjya māno maharṣibhiḥ ॥1-16-10॥

translations.english: After Visnu had decided (to incarnate) and he was worshipped by devatas and maharshis he disappeared bidding farewell to Brahma.
translations.hindi: उसे न तो सूर्य ही गर्मी पहुँचा सकते और न वायु देव ही उसके समीप वेग से चल सकते है.। उसे देखते ही समुद्र भी अपना लहणाना बन्द कर शान्त हो जाता हैं

verses.sloka: ततो वै यजमानस्य पावकात् अतुल प्रभम् ।प्रादुर्भूतम् महद्भूतम् महावीर्यम् महाबलम् ॥१-१६-११॥
verses.transliteration: tato vai yajamānasya pāvakāt atula prabham ।prādurbhūtam mahadbhūtam mahāvīryam mahābalam ॥1-16-11॥

translations.english: During the sacrifice, there emerged from the sacrificial fire a mighty being with unmatched splendour, his prowess and strength. He wore a black and crimson garment. He had a red face. His voice was similar to the sounds of a drum. He had whiskers of soft and shining tawny hair resembling the mane of a lion He had fine hair on his head. He was endowed with auspicious signs and adorned with splendid divine ornaments. His height resembled a mountain peak. He walked with the strides of a ferocious tiger. Similar to the Sun in radiance, he looked like the crest of a blazing fire. This divine being held like his beloved wife both hands, a large vessel made of gold purified, in fire, covered with a silver lid and filled with payasam (a preparation of rice in milk and sugar). It looked as though it was created by magic.
translations.hindi: उस भयानक राक्षस को देखने ही से हमें बड़ा डर लगता है । अत: हे भगवन्‌ ! उसके वध के लिए कोई उपाय कीजिए

verses.sloka: कृष्णम् रक्ताम्बर धरम् रक्ताअस्यम् दुन्दुभि स्वनम् ।स्निग्ध हर्यक्ष तनुज श्मश्रु प्रवरम् ऊर्धजम् ॥१-१६-१२॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇam raktāmbara dharam raktāasyam dundubhi svanam ।snigdha haryakṣa tanuja śmaśru pravaram ūrdhajam ॥1-16-12॥

translations.english: During the sacrifice, there emerged from the sacrificial fire a mighty being with unmatched splendour, his prowess and strength. He wore a black and crimson garment. He had a red face. His voice was similar to the sounds of a drum. He had whiskers of soft and shining tawny hair resembling the mane of a lion He had fine hair on his head. He was endowed with auspicious signs and adorned with splendid divine ornaments. His height resembled a mountain peak. He walked with the strides of a ferocious tiger. Similar to the Sun in radiance, he looked like the crest of a blazing fire. This divine being held like his beloved wife both hands, a large vessel made of gold purified, in fire, covered with a silver lid and filled with payasam (a preparation of rice in milk and sugar). It looked as though it was created by magic.
translations.hindi: उन सब देवताओं के ये वचन सुन, त्रा जी कछ सोच कर बोले मैंने उस दुरात्मा के मारने का उपाय सोच लिया है

verses.sloka: शुभ लक्षण संपन्नम् दिव्य आभरण भूषितम् ।शैल शृङ्ग समुत्सेधम् दृप्त शार्दूल विक्रमम् ॥१-१६-१३॥
verses.transliteration: śubha lakṣaṇa saṁpannam divya ābharaṇa bhūṣitam ।śaila śṛṅga samutsedham dṛpta śārdūla vikramam ॥1-16-13॥

translations.english: During the sacrifice, there emerged from the sacrificial fire a mighty being with unmatched splendour, his prowess and strength. He wore a black and crimson garment. He had a red face. His voice was similar to the sounds of a drum. He had whiskers of soft and shining tawny hair resembling the mane of a lion He had fine hair on his head. He was endowed with auspicious signs and adorned with splendid divine ornaments. His height resembled a mountain peak. He walked with the strides of a ferocious tiger. Similar to the Sun in radiance, he looked like the crest of a blazing fire. This divine being held like his beloved wife both hands, a large vessel made of gold purified, in fire, covered with a silver lid and filled with payasam (a preparation of rice in milk and sugar). It looked as though it was created by magic.
translations.hindi: रावण के वर माँगने पर हमने उसे गन्धर्व, यक्ष, देवता, दानव और राक्षसों ठ्वारा अबध्य होने का वरदान तो अवश्य दे दिया है

verses.sloka: दिवाकर समाअकारम् दीप्त अनल शिखोपमम् ।तप्त जाम्बूनदमयीम् राजतान्त परिच्छदाम् ॥१-१६-१४॥
verses.transliteration: divākara samāakāram dīpta anala śikhopamam ।tapta jāmbūnadamayīm rājatānta paricchadām ॥1-16-14॥

translations.english: During the sacrifice, there emerged from the sacrificial fire a mighty being with unmatched splendour, his prowess and strength. He wore a black and crimson garment. He had a red face. His voice was similar to the sounds of a drum. He had whiskers of soft and shining tawny hair resembling the mane of a lion He had fine hair on his head. He was endowed with auspicious signs and adorned with splendid divine ornaments. His height resembled a mountain peak. He walked with the strides of a ferocious tiger. Similar to the Sun in radiance, he looked like the crest of a blazing fire. This divine being held like his beloved wife both hands, a large vessel made of gold purified, in fire, covered with a silver lid and filled with payasam (a preparation of rice in milk and sugar). It looked as though it was created by magic.
translations.hindi: किन्तु उसने मनुष्यों को कुछ भी न समझ वरदान में मनुष्यों का नाम नहीं लिया था । अतः बह सिवा मनुष्य के और किसी के द्वारा नहीं मारा जा सकता

verses.sloka: दिव्य पायस संपूर्णाम् पात्रीम् पत्नीम् इव प्रियाम् ।प्रगृह्य विपुलाम् दोर्भ्याम् स्वयम् मायामयीम् इव ॥१-१६-१५॥
verses.transliteration: divya pāyasa saṁpūrṇām pātrīm patnīm iva priyām ।pragṛhya vipulām dorbhyām svayam māyāmayīm iva ॥1-16-15॥

translations.english: During the sacrifice, there emerged from the sacrificial fire a mighty being with unmatched splendour, his prowess and strength. He wore a black and crimson garment. He had a red face. His voice was similar to the sounds of a drum. He had whiskers of soft and shining tawny hair resembling the mane of a lion He had fine hair on his head. He was endowed with auspicious signs and adorned with splendid divine ornaments. His height resembled a mountain peak. He walked with the strides of a ferocious tiger. Similar to the Sun in radiance, he looked like the crest of a blazing fire. This divine being held like his beloved wife both hands, a large vessel made of gold purified, in fire, covered with a silver lid and filled with payasam (a preparation of rice in milk and sugar). It looked as though it was created by magic.
translations.hindi: ब्रह्मा जी का यह प्रिय वचन सुन, सब देवता महूर्षि आदि बहुत प्रसन्न हुए

verses.sloka: समवेक्ष्य अब्रवीत् वाक्यम् इदम् दशरथम् नृपम् ।प्राजापत्यम् नरम् विद्धि माम् इह अभ्यागतम् नृप ॥१-१६-१६॥
verses.transliteration: samavekṣya abravīt vākyam idam daśaratham nṛpam ।prājāpatyam naram viddhi mām iha abhyāgatam nṛpa ॥1-16-16॥

translations.english: Having seen king Dasaratha, he said, "O King you know I have been sent by Prjapati (Brahma), and I am here".
translations.hindi: है एतिस्मन्नन्तरे विष्णुरुपयातो महाद्युतिः । शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिः पीतवासा जगत्पतिः

verses.sloka: ततः परम् तदा राजा प्रति उवाच कृत अंजलिः ।भगवन् स्वागतम् तेऽस्तु किमहम् करवाणि ते ॥१-१६-१७॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ param tadā rājā prati uvāca kṛta aṁjaliḥ ।bhagavan svāgatam te'stu kimaham karavāṇi te ॥1-16-17॥

translations.english: With folded palms the king replied, "O revered lord. Welcome to you. What can I do for you?".
translations.hindi: जब विष्णु भगवान्‌ व्रह्मा जी से मिल कर, उनके पास बैठे तब देवताओं ने बड़ी नम्रता के साथ उनकी स्तुतिं की और -कहा-—

verses.sloka: अथो पुनः इदम् वाक्यम् प्राजापत्यो नरोऽब्रवीत् ।राजन् अर्चयता देवान् अद्य प्राप्तम् इदम् त्वया ॥१-१६-१८॥
verses.transliteration: atho punaḥ idam vākyam prājāpatyo naro'bravīt ।rājan arcayatā devān adya prāptam idam tvayā ॥1-16-18॥

translations.english: Thereafter the one who came from Prajapati answered, "O King you have obtained this payasam today in return for the worship offered to the devatas".
translations.hindi: हम लोग आपसे सव की भलाई के लिए यह प्रार्थना करते हैं कि आप धर्मात्मा, दानी ओर ऋषिवत्‌ तेजस्त्री अग्रोध्य़ाधिपवि महाराज दशरथ की ही, श्री ओर कीति के समान तीन रानियां में अपने चार अंशों से पुत्रभाव स्वीकार करें। आप मनुष्य शारीर धारण कर, -महाभिमानी लोककण्टक उस रावण को, जो हम ( देवताओं ) से भी अवध्य है, युद्ध में परास्य करें क्योंकि वह मूर्ख राक्षस रावण देवता, गन्धने, सिद्ध और मुनियों को अपने बल से बहुत सता रहा है

verses.sloka: इदम् तु नृप शार्दूल पायसम् देव निर्मितम् ।प्रजा करम् गृहाण त्वम् धन्यम् आरोग्य वर्धनम् ॥१-१६-१९॥
verses.transliteration: idam tu nṛpa śārdūla pāyasam deva nirmitam ।prajā karam gṛhāṇa tvam dhanyam ārogya vardhanam ॥1-16-19॥

translations.english: "O Lion among kings, receive this payasam prepared by gods, conferring progeny, bestowing affluence and improving health.

verses.sloka: भार्याणाम् अनुरूपाणाम् अश्नीत इति प्रयच्छ वै ।तासु त्वम् लप्स्यसे पुत्रान् यदर्थम् यजसे नृप ॥१-१६-२०॥
verses.transliteration: bhāryāṇām anurūpāṇām aśnīta iti prayaccha vai ।tāsu tvam lapsyase putrān yadartham yajase nṛpa ॥1-16-20॥

translations.english: O King you are performing this sacrifice for the sake of sons. Give this to your worthy consorts to consume it. They will bear you sons".

verses.sloka: तथा इति नृपतिः प्रीतः शिरसा प्रति गृह्य ताम् ।पात्रीम् देव अन्न संपूर्णाम् देव दत्ताम् हिरण्मयीम् ॥१-१६-२१॥
verses.transliteration: tathā iti nṛpatiḥ prītaḥ śirasā prati gṛhya tām ।pātrīm deva anna saṁpūrṇām deva dattām hiraṇmayīm ॥1-16-21॥

translations.english: Dasaratha was pleased to receive respectfully the golden vessel filled with the payasam prepared and bestowed by devatas.

verses.sloka: अभिवाद्य च तत् भूतम् अद्भुतम् प्रिय दर्शनम् ।मुदा परमया युक्तः चकार अभिप्रदक्षिणम् ॥१-१६-२२॥
verses.transliteration: abhivādya ca tat bhūtam adbhutam priya darśanam ।mudā paramayā yuktaḥ cakāra abhipradakṣiṇam ॥1-16-22॥

translations.english: Overwhelmed with great joy, he, walked around that wonderful being of pleasant countenance again and again and saluated him respectfully.

verses.sloka: ततो दशरथः प्राप्य पायसम् देव निर्मितम् ।बभूव परम प्रीतः प्राप्य वित्तम् इव अधनः ॥१-१६-२३॥
verses.transliteration: tato daśarathaḥ prāpya pāyasam deva nirmitam ।babhūva parama prītaḥ prāpya vittam iva adhanaḥ ॥1-16-23॥

translations.english: Dasaratha who received the payasam prepared by devatas was highly pleased like a poor man who received wealth.

verses.sloka: ततः तत् अद्भुत प्रख्यम् भूतम् परम भास्वरम् ।संवर्तयित्वा तत् कर्म तत्र एव अन्तरधीयत ॥१-१६-२४॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ tat adbhuta prakhyam bhūtam parama bhāsvaram ।saṁvartayitvā tat karma tatra eva antaradhīyata ॥1-16-24॥

translations.english: Then that effulgent figure of wonderful form having given the bowl of payasam vanished from there.
translations.hindi: देखिए, उस दुष्ट ने ( इन्द्र के) नन्दनवन नामक उद्यान में क्रीड़ा करते हुए गन्धवा तथा अप्सराओं को सार डाला । उसीको मरवाने के लिए, हम यहाँ मुनिया सहित आए हैं ॥२ सिद्धगन्धवयज्ञाश्च ततस्त्वां शरणं गताः । त्वं गतिः परमा देव समेषां नः परन्तप

verses.sloka: हर्ष रश्मिभिः उद्द्योतम् तस्य अन्तःपुरम् आबभौ ।शारदस्य अभिरामस्य चंद्रस्य इव नभः अंशुभिः ॥१-१६-२५॥
verses.transliteration: harṣa raśmibhiḥ uddyotam tasya antaḥpuram ābabhau ।śāradasya abhirāmasya caṁdrasya iva nabhaḥ aṁśubhiḥ ॥1-16-25॥

translations.english: The inner apartment, brightened with rays of happiness, shone like the autumnal sky in the glow of the moon.

verses.sloka: सः अन्तःपुरम् प्रविश्य एव कौसल्याम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ।पायसम् प्रतिगृह्णीष्व पुत्रीयम् तु इदम् आत्मनः ॥१-१६-२६॥
verses.transliteration: saḥ antaḥpuram praviśya eva kausalyām idam abravīt ।pāyasam pratigṛhṇīṣva putrīyam tu idam ātmanaḥ ॥1-16-26॥

translations.english: He entered the inner apartment and addressing queen Kausalya said, "Receive this payasam which has the power to give you sons".
translations.hindi: सर्बेलोकों से नमस्कार किए जाने वाले अर्थात्‌ सवेपूज्य भग- वान्‌ विष्णु ने, शरण आए हुए एकत्रित नह्मादि देवताओं से कहा-

verses.sloka: कौसल्यायै नरपतिः पायस अर्धम् ददौ तदा ।अर्धात् अर्धम् ददौ च अपि सुमित्रायै नराधिपः ॥१-१६-२७॥
verses.transliteration: kausalyāyai narapatiḥ pāyasa ardham dadau tadā ।ardhāt ardham dadau ca api sumitrāyai narādhipaḥ ॥1-16-27॥

translations.english: Then Dasaratha gave half the portion of payasam to Kausalya, half of the remaining half to Sumitra, half of the remaining portion (oneeighth of original) to Kaikeyi for the sake of a son. On further thinking, he gave the remaining oneeighth portion to Sumitra. In this manner the king divided and distributed the payasam among his wives separately.
translations.hindi: हे देवताओ ! तुम्हारा मङ्गल हो; तुम अव मत डरो। तुम्हारे हित के लिए मैं रावण से लड़ूँगा। में पुत्र, पौत्र, मंत्री, मित्र, जाति वालों तथा बन्धुवान्धव सहित, उस क्रूर, दुष्ट और देवताओं तथा ऋषियों के लिये भयप्रद रावण को मार कर और ग्यारह हजार वर्ष तक मत्येलोक में रह कर, इस प्रथिवी का पालन करूँगा

verses.sloka: कैकेय्यै च अवशिष्ट अर्धम् ददौ पुत्रार्थ कारणात् ।प्रददौ च अवशिष्ट अर्धम् पायसस्य अमृत उपमम् ॥१-१६-२८॥
verses.transliteration: kaikeyyai ca avaśiṣṭa ardham dadau putrārtha kāraṇāt ।pradadau ca avaśiṣṭa ardham pāyasasya amṛta upamam ॥1-16-28॥

translations.english: Then Dasaratha gave half the portion of payasam to Kausalya, half of the remaining half to Sumitra, half of the remaining portion (oneeighth of original) to Kaikeyi for the sake of a son. On further thinking, he gave the remaining oneeighth portion to Sumitra. In this manner the king divided and distributed the payasam among his wives separately.

verses.sloka: अनुचिन्त्य सुमित्रायै पुनः एव महीपतिः ।एवम् तासाम् ददौ राजा भार्याणाम् पायसम् पृथक् ॥१-१६-२९॥
verses.transliteration: anucintya sumitrāyai punaḥ eva mahīpatiḥ ।evam tāsām dadau rājā bhāryāṇām pāyasam pṛthak ॥1-16-29॥

translations.english: Then Dasaratha gave half the portion of payasam to Kausalya, half of the remaining half to Sumitra, half of the remaining portion (oneeighth of original) to Kaikeyi for the sake of a son. On further thinking, he gave the remaining oneeighth portion to Sumitra. In this manner the king divided and distributed the payasam among his wives separately.

verses.sloka: ताः च एवम् पायसम् प्राप्य नरेन्द्रस्य उत्तमाः स्त्रियः ।सम्मानम् मेनिरे सर्वाः प्रहर्ष उदित चेतसः ॥१-१६-३०॥
verses.transliteration: tāḥ ca evam pāyasam prāpya narendrasya uttamāḥ striyaḥ ।sammānam menire sarvāḥ praharṣa udita cetasaḥ ॥1-16-30॥

translations.english: The virtuous wives of the king were exceedingly delighted and felt honoured after receiving the payasam .
translations.hindi: कमलनयन भगवान्‌ विष्णु ने अपने चार रूपों से महाराज दशरथ को अपना पिता बनाना, अर्थात्‌ उनके घर में जन्म लेना पसंद किया

verses.sloka: ततस्तु ताः प्राश्य तद् उत्तम स्त्रियोमहीपतेः उत्तम पायसम् पृथक् ।हुताशन आदित्य समान तेजसःअचिरेण गर्भान् प्रतिपेदिरे तदा ॥१-१६-३१॥
verses.transliteration: tatastu tāḥ prāśya tad uttama striyomahīpateḥ uttama pāyasam pṛthak ।hutāśana āditya samāna tejasaḥacireṇa garbhān pratipedire tadā ॥1-16-31॥

translations.english: Then the excellent consorts of the king who glowed like fire and the Sun, having consumed the choicest payasam, became pregnant in a short time.
translations.hindi: तब देवर्षि, गन्धर्व, रुद्र, अप्सरागण--इन सब ने मधुसूदन भगवान्‌ की स्तुति कर, उनको सन्तुष्ट किया

verses.sloka: ततस्तु राजा प्रतिवीक्ष्य ताः स्त्रियःप्ररूढ गर्भाः प्रति लब्ध मानसः ।बभूव हृष्टः त्रिदिवे यथा हरिःसुरेन्द्र सिद्ध ऋषि गणाभिपूजितः ॥१-१६-३२॥
verses.transliteration: tatastu rājā prativīkṣya tāḥ striyaḥprarūḍha garbhāḥ prati labdha mānasaḥ ।babhūva hṛṣṭaḥ tridive yathā hariḥsurendra siddha ṛṣi gaṇābhipūjitaḥ ॥1-16-32॥

translations.english: The king now regained his composure of mind on seeing his pregnant wives. He looked delighted like Visnu worshipped by Indra, and hosts of siddhas and rishis. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे षोडशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the sixteenth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: इति पञ्चदशः सग; || ओर कहा, हे प्रभो ! इस उद्दण्ड, बड़े तेजस्वी, अत्यन्त अहंकारी, देवताओं के शत्रु, लोकों को रुलाने वाले, साधु तपस्वियों को सताने वाले और भयदाता - रावण को; नाश कीजिए । लोकों को रुलाने वाले और उम्र पुरुषार्थी उस रावण को वंधु-बान्धव तथा सेना सहित मार कर र संसार के दुःख को दूर कर, इन्द्रपालित तथा पाप एवं . दोषशून्य स्वर्ग में पधारिए
